fato_historico: 1356: Basel earthquake, the most significant historic seismological event north of the Alps, destroys the town of Basel, Switzerland.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider that even when the earth shifts beneath your feet—much like the ancient tremors that once reshaped the historic foundations of Basel—your inner grace remains unshakable. It is a good time to focus on restoring balance within your personal landscape. You may discover that stability comes from embracing change rather than fearing the tremors of life.
frase_do_dia: True balance is found in the heart, not in the stillness of the world.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of wisdom and inner strength through life cycles.
conselho: Trust in your ability to adapt gracefully whenever unexpected changes arise today.
